s: Record earnings; price the cycle with care
A strong operator at a cyclical earnings peak
Initiate Neutral with a 12-month target of INR 530, derived from 12x FY28
EQe EPS of INR 43.93. Current earnings look inexpensive, but extrapolating
record silver-led profitability would overstate a sustainable earnings base.
Our forecast explicitly allows margins to normalise.
The September consolidated filing shows INR 13,287 crore of operating cash
flow and INR 3,152 crore of capital purchases in H1 FY27. After INR 116
crore of lease principal and interest, that leaves INR 10,019 crore before other
investing and financing flows. This is a cash bridge, not FCFF.
FY27 revenue EQe is INR 57,000 crore and statutory operating EBITDA
margin 60%. FY28 revenue falls to INR 52,500 crore and margin to 54% as
price realisations normalise; FY29 revenue recovers to INR 56,500 crore.
These are Equinox scenarios, not management guidance.
Sustained high realisations with controlled costs would support the bull case.
A sharp metals reversal, weaker grades, expansion overruns or large cash
distributions could impair earnings and reinvestment. The position is exposed
to both industrial and precious-metal cycles.

Risks and evidence that could invalidate the view
Silver and zinc realisations can dominate changes in volumes and operating costs. The revenue scenario is aggregated: no
independently verified current metal-price curve or hedge-book mark is embedded. INR movements can affect revenue and
Underground grades, recoveries, mine development, safety, water availability, tailings and energy reliability affect both
output and sustaining costs. A low reported zinc COP excluding royalties is not the complete economic cost. Silver
by-product credits make zinc cost comparisons sensitive to commodity prices.
The annual report discloses promoter pledges and non-disposal undertakings; NSE flags overall encumbered shares above
50%. Do not equate this with all shares pledged. Parent funding needs, stake sales and dividend decisions can affect the
minority shareholder experience. Ownership and encumbrance figures require fresh filings before a transaction.
Q2 company headline EBITDA is9,285 while statutory operating EBITDA is9,248. The report consistently forecasts
statutory operating EBITDA: revenue less operating costs, excluding other income. FY26 equivalent is22,064 versus
management headline22,162. FY25 is17,388. Management KPIs are quoted separately, without assigning an unsupported
The DCF assumes continuing operations with reinvestment and a permanent 3% terminal growth rate. It is sensitive to
reserve replenishment, prices and capital intensity. The forecast CFO is simplified, and full forecast balance sheets and
financing schedules are not constructed. These limitations prevent a claim of a fully integrated three-statement model.
Risks are issuer-specific research considerations, not a personalised investment suitability assessment.
